content.assumptions: Let A ⊆ B(Hₐₜ) be the fixed unital C*-algebra obtained by adjoining the chosen shell-link unitaries to the atomic representation of the CAR algebra C, and then taking the norm-closed unital *-algebra they generate. Let Hτ = L²(C, τC) be the GNS Hilbert space of the normalized CAR trace τC. Let ρ be the specified representation obtained by pointed unitary transport of the tracial model.
content.conclusion: ρ is injective: for all a, b ∈ A, ρ(a) = ρ(b) implies a = b. In particular, ρ(a) = 0 implies a = 0.
content.display_title: Faithfulness of the separable tracial representation
content.lean_realization_notes: The literal conclusion is Function.Injective separableCounterexampleRepresentation. Separability of Hτ is a separate established fact; the isometry property and the faithfulness of the scalar trace are separate statements as well. Injectivity does not imply irreducibility here.
content.natural_language_statement: The tracial representation ρ: A → B(Hτ) of the fixed CAR-based algebra on the CAR trace-GNS space is faithful.
content.one_sentence_role: Proves injectivity of the specified representation rather than introducing a new algebra or a new witness.

proof_steps.text: Take the established injectivity theorem for the trace model of a representative shell family.
Apply it to the same family used to define A and ρ.

content.proof_summary: Specialize injectivity of the family-parametric trace-model representation to the fixed homogeneity family.
